title: Artificial Analysis vs Arena: What Each AI Ranking Measures
description: Understand the difference between a benchmark composite and human preference ranking before using either to choose an API model.
tldr: Artificial Analysis combines benchmark results in an intelligence index. Arena derives ratings from human pairwise preferences. Neither ranking is a direct estimate of your own task accuracy or API value.

sections.heading: The questions are different
sections.body: Artificial Analysis publishes a composite intelligence score based on its selected evaluations. Arena rankings come from people comparing anonymized model responses. The first emphasizes performance on a benchmark set; the second measures preference among the responses and voters represented in Arena. Their scales are not interchangeable.

sections.heading: What a high score can hide
sections.body: A model may excel at reasoning benchmarks and still perform poorly on your support queue, extraction schema or style requirements. Arena votes may favor fluency or formatting that your application does not value. Scores also change with dataset updates, model versions and ranking methodology. Read each project's methodology and check the date of any chart.

sections.heading: Use rankings as a shortlist
sections.body: Select a few models that meet your requirements for latency, context, region and supported modalities. Run the same representative tasks on all candidates. Score pass/fail outcomes with a rubric; where judgment matters, blind the evaluator to model identity. Track token usage and retries so a public ranking does not obscure your operating cost.

sections.heading: Price the winner using your workload
sections.body: Input and output volumes may differ substantially between models, and a model that needs more retries can cost more than its published token rate implies. [Compare model prices](/tools/compare-prices), then compute cost per successful task from your own evaluation. Treat benchmark rank as one piece of evidence, not a purchasing decision.

faq.question: Is Arena Elo the same as the Artificial Analysis score?
faq.answer: No. They use different data and methods, and their numeric scales are not comparable.
